attackers_goals: The attacker attempts to gain access to the organization's resources.
description: A user interactively logged in to Azure AD via PowerShell.
investigative_actions: Analyze the actions taken by the user during the session and verify that this is a legitimate session. Look for signs that the user account is compromised (e.g. abnormal logins, unusual activity).
name: Suspicious Azure AD interactive sign-in using PowerShell

variations.description: A user interactively logged in to Azure AD via PowerShell from an unusual geolocation or ASN.
